usedFor: Systeme.io holds your new contacts, and Gmail emails them through “Send Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Systeme.io, then “Send Email” in Gmail
bestTemplate.why: A new contact gets an email from your own Gmail, with subject and body set once in the template.

watchOut: An email to a new contact waits in Needs you, and “Send Email” only goes after you approve it.
